name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This pin (master HEAD d09cdb9e, PR #114) fixes the iOS 'parler: DAC decode failed' failure, which had two compounding causes. The DAC compute arena was unbounded in output length (~13.6 + 1.957 * n_frames MiB) and streaming re-decoded the whole prefix per chunk, so the streaming path walked ~10 growing allocations up to 837 MiB -- fatal on iOS, where Metal buffers use posix_memalign, and invisible on macOS, which uses vm_allocate. DAC decode now runs in fixed 128-frame windows that consult the surrounding frames as convolution context, so peak DAC memory is O(1) in output length, each window is bit-identical to slicing a whole-sequence decode, and streaming is 2.2-2.5x faster. Separately, argmax decoding is degenerate for this model family (silence attractor after the first word, and EOS gated on codebook 0's argmax, so it never terminates), so the engine now always samples: greedy and top_k = 1 are repaired to the model's sampled defaults with a warning. Carries the prior pin (928369c9, PR #110) that put the full Parler pipeline on Vulkan, the Metal GPU pin (67c7ad3a, PR #103), and the CosyVoice3 pin (PR #99). The ggml-speech floor is unchanged -- this release is engine-side only.
